correctness.rationale: The exact terminal matrix is Σ_{j=0}^k binom(N,j)G^(N−j)(F−G)^j. Joint unitary diagonalization reduces operator norm to the scalar truncated binomial polynomial on |z|=1. Independently expanded its real-coefficient Chebyshev squared modulus using u=1−Re(z) and verified all four symbolic polynomial defects for free N and u. Their N-prefactors are positive for N>=k+1, giving the exact iff thresholds including Δ=0 and scalar boundary equality. Finite matrix trials and verified source recurrence are secondary; k>=N yields exact F^N but is excluded from four frontier domains.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact stability-design invariant for phase-inaccurate, nondissipative parallel time integration: the first two correction sweeps can never be terminally contractive under nonzero mismatch, but k=3/4 admit sharp, realizable O(1/N) phase windows. The exact order-by-order boundary distinguishes physically relevant stability regimes and not just a tabulated polynomial identity.

final_claim: For commuting unitaries F,G, N>=k+1 identical windows, terminal Parareal P_N,k is nonexpansive iff Δ=0 for k=1,2, Δ²<=3/[(N−1)(N−2)] for k=3, and Δ²<=8/[(N−1)(N−3)] for k=4; boundaries scalar-attainable.
